opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University Development Office should coordinate applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; maximum grant amount £100,000; usual range £15,000–£50,000 (equipment), £15,000–£100,000 (new build/refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results, 'Good' or above inspection rating, and demonstrable excellence.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve teaching of GCSE and A-Level subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a fully accredited museum/gallery holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority working with disability, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards projects for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charity or local authority providing care and services for older people, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance that are open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS providing excellent care to patients and their families, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating an accredited library/archive holding a permanent collection of national significance and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £15,000; usual grant range £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, able to make a case for the significance of its education work within the sector.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount £25,000; usual grant range £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority running special schools/colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects supporting pupils at secondary level in special schools and colleges to develop skills for employment or independent living after school/college. Two-stage application process.
